summary: Add ordered native kernel programs and the Rust-mirrored batched prefix-sum hierarchy.
regressions: Native two-stage dependent-buffer dispatch across repeated iterations; reject missing, aliased and incorrectly sized mappings
Thirty integer cases cover empty and partial blocks, multiple batches, and a 65537-element three-level scan
Every scratch buffer and guard word compared; full scans also checked against independent exclusive sums
Ordered handoffs require every referenced stage and its hashes; removing a stage source is rejected
Explicitly expand the eight tree stages before Ascend thread-sync analysis; generated source preserves group-uniform barriers without the pragma-loop barrier-hoisting warning.
differences: No Rust arithmetic or physics changes. CPU serializes the same 256-lane tree phases; GPU uses actual shared memory barriers.
Empty scans execute an explicit no-op, avoiding the Rust host workspace reserve loop for zero stride.
No CPU physics or readback between native stages; synchronous queue completion is a correctness implementation, not optimized scheduling.
Contracts currently exclude u32 overflow to retain checked debug Rust oracle execution. Ascend source lowering remains distinct from vendor compilation and NPU execution.
